name: Nervous
overview: Scripture addresses nervousness by encouraging believers to place unwavering trust in the Lord rather than their own understanding, as Proverbs 3:5 instructs. God's Word provides guidance and reassurance, serving as a lamp to our feet and light to our path (Psalms 119:105), while Isaiah 41:10 promises God's presence, strength, and help in times of fear. Believers are called to be bold and confident like a lion (Proverbs 28:1), transformed by renewing their minds to discern God's perfect will (Romans 12:2), and assured of God's good plans for their future (Jeremiah 29:11), all of which counteracts nervousness with faith and courage.
